scope: Remote reproduction of the corrected flower-task VACE smoke dataset
summary: The corrected 12-train/4-validation paired dataset reproduced on a800-1 with zero declared attachment error and was accepted only as synthetic trainer input.
evidence: The remote dataset contains 16 clips of 17 frames with maximum declared contact error 0 pixels.
It was generated from the isolated code snapshot at outputs/flower-task-adaptation/20260811T003000Z-code-snapshot-v1.
lessons: Copying a small code snapshot and regenerating data on the execution host avoids relying on unrecorded local assets during training.
limitations: Remote reproduction does not make the procedural data representative of real flower handling.
next_actions: Require pinned trainer and checkpoint provenance before starting any GPU job.
